from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

harness = r'''
from preferences import Preferences
from repository import Repository, ScriptedBackend, TransientRead, MissingPreference
import sys

key = sys.argv[1]
scenarios = [
    ("success_first", [{"color": "blue"}, TransientRead("unused")]),
    ("success_second", [TransientRead("busy-1"), {"color": "blue"}]),
    ("success_third", [TransientRead("busy-1"), TransientRead("busy-2"), {"color": "blue"}]),
    ("transients_exhausted", [TransientRead("busy-1"), TransientRead("busy-2"), TransientRead("busy-3")]),
    ("missing_first", [MissingPreference("missing"), {"color": "blue"}]),
    ("transient_then_missing", [TransientRead("busy-1"), MissingPreference("missing"), {"color": "blue"}]),
]
for name, outcomes in scenarios:
    backend = ScriptedBackend(outcomes)
    try:
        result = Preferences(Repository(backend)).read(key)
        outcome = repr(result)
    except Exception as exc:
        outcome = type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc)
    print(name, "=>", outcome, "keys=", repr(backend.keys))
'''

paths = ["preferences.py", "repository.py", "reader.py", "tests/test_reads.py"]
for revision, label, keys in [("HEAD:", "HEAD 7c0410c", ["w"]), (":", "staged index", ["w", " w "])]:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="preference-review-") as directory:
        for path in paths:
            target = Path(directory, path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", revision + path]))
        suite = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "unittest", "discover", "-s", "tests", "-v"], cwd=directory, text=True, capture_output=True)
        print(label, "suite exit:", suite.returncode)
        print(suite.stdout + suite.stderr)
        for key in keys:
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", "-c", harness, key], cwd=directory, text=True, capture_output=True)
            print(label, "key:", repr(key), "harness exit:", result.returncode)
            print(result.stdout + result.stderr)
PY
